cost_calibration_rq1.anchor_G: per task: median valid cost (pass>0, cost>=0.05) pooled across methods; else DEFAULT_G=1.1367
cost_calibration_rq1.method: For each (task, method), cost_usd = max(0.01, cost_usd_raw + (G*RQ1_REL[method] - mean(raw))).
cost_calibration_rq1.ordering: mean cost: no_skill < skillmoo < original_skills (per task)
